title: Vignette 2026-11-02: essays are working through ideas and must not break CI; the core case keeps evolving and must stay editable

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Owner, 2026-11-02, on the muDemocracy.org conformance CI (muDemocracy.org#171, PR #421, asks A3 and A4): "ok. lets look at this conformance. 

Yes. Essays are essays. We are working through ideas. They should not break ci. 
The core case is going to keep evolving. I need to be able to keep editing it."

Owner answers in the same session (multiple choice, put by Claude Code): placement and completeness checks → "Warn everywhere (Recommended)"; content/ drift and verified-quote-without-text → "Both warn (Recommended)".

Owner, same session, on ask A4 (whether to publish five new history claims in The core case): "why is A4 blocking? 
I am going to always be updating my claims?"
